mostWorthwhile.text: Adding particles to the mucus-lined airway was most worthwhile: it showed how mucus catches them and the tiny hairs move them toward the throat.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the already-built defenses to the body felt repetitive; the insets were clear, but these steps added less about how the defenses work.

surprise.text: I was interested to see the white blood cell not just surround a bacterium but also break it apart.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final connections were the only available combinations rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I might continue to see another body defense, since the two different ways of handling inhaled material were clear and interesting. I'd hope for more meaningful choices than the final assembly steps.
